'''''Selfless''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It transported [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Keelyvine Reus]], her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Tyzen Xebec]], [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ganch]], and the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]] member [[Sanya]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] following the [[battle of Ukio]].
